_about.note: Marker sets for English regional variants. Siblings are expressed against the American forms, because the shipped catalogue resolves bare `en` to en-US (CLDR likelySubtags) and that is what an unqualified request gets.
_about.source: Drafted from the schema in docs/01 from well-established, non-contested British/Australian vs American differences. NOT human-reviewed by a native speaker; every entry carries `reviewed: false` until it is.
_about.scoring: Comparative. A variant marker is a hit, the sibling's marker in the same slot is a miss, and an item where neither appears is void -- the elicitation context failed, not the model.
_about.on-inflections: Single-word markers match their regular English inflections (neighbour/neighbours, organise/organising), so only base forms are listed. Listing an inflected form as well would let one word score twice.
_about.on-suffixes: Orthography markers are spelled out as whole words rather than written as suffixes. `-our` would match hour/four/your, `-or` would match doctor/motor, and `-ise` would match wise/rise/promise -- all identical in both variants, all silent false hits. The suffix form is supported by the loader and is safe only where no unrelated word shares the ending, such as -isation/-ization.
